title: Playing backwards fast keeps the picture moving on a full-screen recording
goal: Pressing J two or three times plays a recording backwards at 4x or 8x. On a full-screen Retina recording nobody has checked whether the picture keeps up at those speeds or sits on one frame while the playhead runs. Measure it, and if the picture falls behind, make it keep moving the way it now does at 1x and 2x.
notes: From the rough list of queue/audits/2026-10-08-playing-backwards-keeps-up.json: 'J J J (4x) and faster backwards read no further ahead than 2x does, so the window's memory stays bounded. At those speeds the picture can fall behind, holding the last frame rather than going blank. Not measured, and no task filed for it.' Measure first: if the numbers come back clean, write them in the log and mark done with no code change. Prior work: tasks playing-backwards-with-j-keeps-up-on-a-full-scre, a-full-screen-retina-recording-keeps-up-while-it. Fixture action openLongRetinaTalk; expectPlaybackNeverBlank-style looks exist in the harness. Walks with setup front:true need the Mac to itself; prefer a non-front walk if the timing allows.
acceptance: A walk on the long full-screen Retina talk plays backwards at 4x and at 8x (J J J and J J J J from a stop) and looks at the canvas at least 20 times each, recording how many looks show a frame more than 3 frames from the playhead; the numbers are written into this task's log before any change
If any look is late, the fix brings both speeds to 0 late looks in three runs in a row, with the window's memory still bounded (state the peak in the log)
No main thread pass over 50 ms while shuttling backwards at either speed
Playing forwards and backwards at 1x and 2x stay at 0 late looks (the walks from the playback tasks stay green)
Audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Measured before any change to the reading (walk playing-backwards-fast-keeps-moving-walk, long Retina talk 2880x1800, 24 looks over 2s from the end): 4x (J J J) 0 of 24 looks late in every run. 8x (J J J J) 12 of 24 late up to 13 frames; then 8 of 24 more than 3 frames behind (up to 12) and 9 of 24 (up to 12) in two more runs. Main thread longest pass while shuttling: 4.8ms at 4x, 2.9ms at 8x.

Found on the way: J J J from a stop at the end STOPPED playback on the third J (rate 0, reproduced 3 times on the long Retina talk). Cause: a speed change cancels the clock task mid-sleep, try? Task.sleep swallows the cancel, and the stale task read the new clock's start with nothing elapsed: landing == last frame == 'reached the end' -> pause. Fixed in EditorState+Time.swift (stale clock stands down; each direction checks only its own boundary; a cancelled pre-roll leaves the start alone).

After the fix (every third frame kept at 8x, MoviePlayBackward.stride; same frame budget as 4x, 45 frames): 8x 0 of 24 looks more than 3 behind in 5 runs in a row (an every-second-frame try had 1 look 4 behind in 1 of 5 runs, so went to every third); 4x 0 of 24 in every run. Main thread longest pass while shuttling 2.4ms at 4x, 4.1ms at 8x. Memory: probe peak RSS 1880MB, plateau 1.7-1.8GB at both 4x and 8x vs 1.15GB idle with the 5-min Retina talk open. Regression walks green: playing-a-recording-backwards-keeps-up (-1x, -2x 0 late), playing-a-recording-never-blinks (1x 0 late), play-in-to-out, play-in-to-out-from-the-ruler, premiere-keys-on-the-timeline, timeline-keys-on-open, first-press-of-play-answers-at-once, shift-m-jumps-between-markers, x-marks-the-clip, view-to-edit-on-a-long-recording, transport-volume. Scripts/test.sh: 11910 tests passed.

left rough: forward 2x from a cold stop on the long Retina talk, the first look (0.1s in) showed frame 0 with frame 3 wanted; the other 23 looks were on time (2 runs, temp walk). Pre-existing start-up of the forward pass, untouched by this work; a 0.1s start nobody is likely to see, so not filed. Audit rough lines: no-mock, 8x granularity and memory are statements, not defects; nothing filed.

8x backwards (J J J J) now keeps up on the 5-min Retina talk: 0 of 24 looks more than 3 frames behind in 5 runs (was 8-12 of 24, up to 13 frames); 4x was already clean and stays 0. Blocks read behind the playhead keep every third frame at 8x (MoviePlayBackward.stride), same 45-frame budget as 4x, peak RSS 1.88GB. Also fixed J J J from a stop at the end stopping on the third press (stale clock task, EditorState+Time.swift). Main thread under 5ms while shuttling.
